title: Zero and addition laws for the explicit signed source-Hom mates
statement: Let D be a preadditive closed monoidal category with additive tensor, additive integer shifts and a CommShift₂Int structure on its tensor bifunctor. For M in D put H(K)=ihom(K,M), a functor D^op→D, with the triangulated opposite shift K[n]=K[-n]. Let a_n(K)=(-1)^(n(n+1)/2) times the right-adjoint mate siteHomOppositeSourceShift(K,n), evaluated at M, including its specified transport -(-n)=n. Then a_0 is the canonical zero-shift comparison. For every m,n and X in D^op, a_(m+n)(X)=H(shiftFunctorAdd_op(m,n).hom_X)≫a_n(X[m])≫S_n(a_m(X))≫shiftFunctorAdd(m,n).inv_(H(X)). These are equations of the prescribed maps, without assuming a CommShift structure on H or claiming triangulatedness.

proof.text: Prove naturality of the left tensor comparison from the two tensor-shift naturality identities. Apply conjugateEquiv_comp and conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft to transpose this into source-Hom naturality, and transport -(-n)=n. Scalar multiplication then gives naturality of the prescribed signed components. Assemble these components into explicit natural isomorphisms e(n); no data is selected from an existence theorem.

At zero unfold the tensor parameter comparison and use both CommShift zero laws. Their middle zero unitors cancel. Expand the right-adjoint mate using conjugateEquiv_apply_app. Naturality of coevaluation cancels the remaining shifted zero unitor and its inverse. Naturality of the inverse zero unitor identifies the resulting map with pre(zeroUnitor.inv_K) followed by zeroUnitor.inv on ihom(K,M). The opposite-category zero-unitor formula identifies this with CommShift.isoZero. The quadratic scalar at zero is 1. This entire calculation is proved in Lean.

Use [lem-sf-native-hom-source-shift-successor], the raw recurrence with second parameter 1. The exact integer identity q(m+1)=q(m)+m+1 follows by expanding (m+1)(m+2)=m(m+1)+2(m+1) and dividing by 2. Therefore (-1)^q(m+1) times (-1)^m equals (-1) times (-1)^q(m). Additivity of the shift and bilinearity of composition turn the raw recurrence into e(m+1)=isoAdd(e(m),e(1)). The scalar identity and this conversion are proved in Lean.

Fix m and prove e(m+n)=isoAdd(e(m),e(n)) by integer induction on n. The base n=0 is the zero law and isoAdd right unitality. The forward step is the successor law plus isoAdd associativity. For the backward step compare both candidate isomorphisms after adding e(1); associativity and the already known next case identify these sums. Cancel the invertible shift-addition maps and e(1), and use faithfulness of the degree-one shift to cancel that functor. This proves the previous case and hence all negative n. Evaluate the natural-isomorphism equality at X to obtain the exact original addition formula. All induction, cancellation and final assembly are complete Lean proofs.

proof_origin.note: Proved zero and naturality directly by mates; reduced arbitrary addition to the raw degree-one recurrence by a proved quadratic-sign identity and integer induction using isoAdd associativity and faithful shift cancellation.

from.place: Proof, second paragraph: internal Hom is triangulated in the first variable and the exact comparison pullback carries triangles to triangles, so the comparison maps form morphisms of triangles. This node supplies the native signed shifts used in that clause.

lean.statement:
theorem siteHom_signed_source_shift_laws [MonoidalPreadditive D] (M : D) :
    let H := MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M
    (∀ X : Dᵒᵖ, siteHomSignedSourceComponent M 0 X =
      (Functor.CommShift.isoZero H ℤ).hom.app X) ∧
    (∀ (m n : ℤ) (X : Dᵒᵖ), siteHomSignedSourceComponent M (m + n) X =
      H.map ((shiftFunctorAdd Dᵒᵖ m n).hom.app X) ≫
        siteHomSignedSourceComponent M n (X⟦m⟧) ≫
        (siteHomSignedSourceComponent M m X)⟦n⟧' ≫
        (shiftFunctorAdd D m n).inv.app (H.obj X))
lean.note: The four map definitions are publicly reexported from NativeHomSourceShiftData. The theorem has its original signature; zero and the full integer-induction assembly are proved, with one strictly narrower raw degree-one recurrence left in NativeHomSourceShiftSuccessor.
